Subject: Post-call recap + proposal: three-way rotating demo windows

Hi Emma / Liam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and three concrete next steps so we can lock in a technical deep-dive 

Recap (2 min):
- Goal: evaluate Redwood's inference stack for Helios' outpatient triage assistant (low-latency, private deployment option).
- Key constraints you called out: EU data residency for analytics, APAC clinical QA team prefers morning hours, and a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive including ops, security, and a brief live demo.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive (60–75m) — we want to accommodate your teams across US/EU/APAC.
2) Share a Mutual Action Plan draft (attached) — please flag edits.
3) Assign an internal Ops contact for SOC2 evidence (Monica is looping in security docs).

Scheduling note — suggested rotating windows (keeps the same weekday/time but rotates which region it favors each week):
- Option A (Week A - US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / 18:00 BST / Wed 03:00 AEST
- Option B (Week B - EU-friendly): Tue 16:00 BST / 08:00 PT / Wed 01:00 AEST
- Option C (Week C - APAC-friendly): Wed 09:00 AEST / Tue 16:00 PT / 00:00 BST

If these feel heavy, we can do a single one-off that suits your core reviewers. Recommended: start with Option B (EU-friendly) given you have EU stakeholders, then rotate weekly so no single team always sacrifices prime hours.

Please reply with which option you prefer and a couple of dates that work (we can send the invite).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (draft dates / owners / milestones)

Thanks — I'll coordinate invites once you confirm.

Best,
Rachel Kim
